added_failures_note: the reviewed manifest records an after_suite arm at fa74d76b (completed true, failure_count 0) and no baseline_suite, so the added count is taken from the readable head arm as 0

findings.text: follow-on: the negative-control mutation the manifest designates (vertical-shift-mutation.log) was produced at revision 3558388a, an earlier pre-review commit rather than the reviewed head fa74d76b; the guarded test body is unchanged in the gained range and the head arm passed, so the firing is demonstrated on an older revision.

item_verdicts.call_sites: scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py is the only production caller of the changed module; no nova runtime module imports nova/imas/prescribed_plasma (the prescribed_current methods in nova/equilibrium/forward.py are a distinct mechanism).
item_verdicts.diff: read the 14 commits ab99b4850..fa74d76b7 commit by commit; the code is nova/imas/profiles.py (closed_plasma_boundary signature and the shapely mask), nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py (section_grid reuse, X-point and stored-outline branches), scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py (time interpolation, flux sign and gauge, tolerance gate), tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py and the docs/figures.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names centroid within one grid cell, reported scale factors, a stated linked-flux tolerance at coils and flux loops, the 1 cm control and audit-doc; scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:663 now asserts the centroid bound, measure.py:675 the per-target tolerance and measure.py:659 the control, with results in delivery-geometric-105014.log and delivery-geometric-105052.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to prescribe the ITER plasma current distribution from DINA's closed separatrix and flux functions scaled to DINA's current and compute its linked flux; the gained commits extend nova/imas/profiles.py:closed_plasma_boundary with an X-point cut and a stored-boundary preference and rebuild nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:plasma_linked_flux on the shared section_grid quadrature.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md and landing.md; they report 867/867 and 2036/2036 prescribed slices, centroid maxima 4.303 and 27.817 mm against a 93.75 mm cell, geometric VS3 residual maxima 1.081 and 2.523 Wb against case bounds, the 105014/1 magnetics-loop maximum 0.872 Wb, and name the per-case gate logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are nova/imas/{profiles,equilibrium,prescribed_plasma}.py, the three test files, scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma, docs/research/iter-prescribed-plasma.html, docs/figures/iter-prescribed-plasma and the evidence fragment; every one of the 12 changed paths in the 14-commit diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py:176 guards the linkage against current-share regression by comparing history[:,0] to 3*plasma_flux_at_points at a known point, and the gate's refusals are shown by vertical-share and tightened logs.
justifications.evidence: scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:663 and measure.py:675 assert the centroid and residual bounds the done_when states and delivery-geometric-105014.log records GATE_PASS with the tolerance table.
justifications.fit: the added names (native_flux_sign, boundary_source values separatrix_x_point/boundary_outline) are capability-named with no plan or version labels and follow nova/imas/profiles.py style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/profiles.py:closed_plasma_boundary and nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:plasma_linked_flux implement the boundary selection and the generic conductor linkage the goal names, now covering both DINA cases.
justifications.reuse: nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:78 now calls nova/circuit/linkage.py:section_grid for filament circuits and the mask uses the shapely contains_xy the module already imports, so the earlier duplicate sub-gridding is gone.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --stat ab99b4850..fa74d76b7 is inside the declared write paths and no file outside the goal's scope is touched.
